title: A Horizon for the Current
author: Marguerite Marchetti
blurb: Zephyrine Pemberton, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
